visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-viewport-width photo hero with a dark overlay and left-aligned eyebrow, display H1, lead paragraph and two CTAs
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed background image, text overlaid left-aligned inside a 1200px content width
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-bleed photo background with dark overlay; left-aligned white text: eyebrow tag pill, very large uppercase display h1, lead paragraph, filled primary button + ghost outline button. Article variant: optional author byline row below the h1 with a small circular avatar (~48px) beside a bold name line and a smaller muted date · read-time line.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: eyebrow paragraph, H1 title, lead paragraph, CTA links (bold link = primary button, italic link = secondary button), optional byline (avatar image, name paragraph, meta paragraph)
rows: Eyebrow paragraph, H1, lead paragraph, CTA links, optional byline: avatar image + name paragraph + meta paragraph (e.g. "February 2026 · 12 min read")
contentPattern.notes: The first picture in the block becomes the background, wherever it is authored. The paragraph directly before the heading is the eyebrow. Paragraphs containing only a link are grouped as the CTA row. Without an image the block renders as a plain text hero. Optional byline: the first image after the heading, followed by up to three short paragraphs with no links, becomes a byline row (circular avatar, then name, then meta lines). The background image must still come first, in row 1.

usage.description: Top-of-page hero on the WKND Adventures homepage.

reuseGuidance: Use for any page-opening hero with a full-bleed photograph behind overlaid heading text and CTAs.
